description: ConsentLayer helps website owners set up and manage GDPR, CCPA, and LGPD cookie consent through ChatGPT. It can provision a site, scan for tracking technologies, configure consent categories and banner behavior, generate installation snippets, verify a live installation, and manage ongoing compliance workflows such as scanner reviews, geolocation rules, cookie policies, and Do Not Sell requests.

defaultPrompt: Set up a cookie consent banner for my website
Scan my website and tell me which trackers and cookies it uses.
Change my consent banner to match my brand colors
